details: I have tried to play a few times since this has started, with any avatar from the game or private avatars, the fingers will not move at all. the thumb will move but every other finger will not move, they wont curl, they just stay in a flat position like im gonna karate chop everything. I have tried every setting and controller bind in steam and inside vrchat to get it to work and it will not work. I have uninstalled and reinstalled, to no avail, and this problem literately just sprang up as I never touch my settings on anything once they are set from the beginning. my fingers have worked and work in every other game besides VRC..  also the touchpads on the index now move me as well. front and back on the left controller, and left and right on the right controller (This I have disabled in steam vr controller binds)  Again I never touched anything and now everything is broken. also the standard mute and jump buttons do not work as well. I have to rebind them in VRC to other buttons to make them work.
title: Index Finger Tracking Not Working
